description: This file defines an abstract validation rule class 'AbstractRule' in the OrangeHRM project, part of its API validation components. It extends a base validation rule from an external validation library and provides an implementation that throws a custom exception upon validation failure.

classes.name: AbstractRule
classes.description: An abstract class extending a base validation rule, which overrides the reportError method to throw a custom ValidationException.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to throw a custom ValidationException, indicating validation failure.
